goal: Is ke baad aap array ka sum aur average nikaal sakte hain, woh elements ginn sakte hain jo koi condition poori karte hain, arrays ko copy aur reverse kar sakte hain, aur shifting se element insert ya delete kar sakte hain.
warmup: Aap ke paanch subjects ke exam marks ek row mein likhe hain. Total janne ke liye aap unhein ek ek karke add karte hain. Average janne ke liye total ko 5 se divide karte hain. Yeh janne ke liye ke kitne subjects mein 60 se zyada marks aaye, aap row mein se guzarte hain aur achhe marks par tick lagate hain. Array program jo bhi karta hai woh isi ek idea par chalta hai: row mein chalo, har box ko dekho, aur ek alag variable mein chhota sa note (total ya counter) rakho.
definition: Zyada tar array tasks ke liye sirf ek loop kaafi hota hai jo index 0 se N - 1 tak har index par jaata hai. Loop ke andar aap ek helper variable update karte hain. Sum mein har element total mein add hota hai. Counter mein jab element if test pass kare to 1 add hota hai. Copy mein a[i] ko b[i] mein bhejte hain. Reverse mein pehla aur aakhri element swap hote hain, phir doosra aur aakhri se doosra, aur isi tarah. Insert ya delete mein jagah banane ya khaali jagah band karne ke liye elements shift hote hain. Array ka size fixed hota hai, is liye 'insert' aur 'delete' ka asal matlab array ke andar hi values ko idhar udhar karna hai.
howItWorks: Sum aur average: sum ko 0 se shuru karein, loop mein a[i] add karein, phir (double)sum / N se divide karein. Count: count ko 0 se shuru karein, aur loop ke andar if (condition) count++ use karein. 'Above average' ke liye pehle average nikaalna hoga, phir doosra loop chalana hoga. Copy: aap b = a nahi likh sakte, kyun ke array ka naam aam variable nahi hota. Ek loop b[i] = a[i] se copy karta hai. Swap: ek temporary box use karein: temp = x; x = y; y = temp. Reverse in place: a[i] ko a[N - 1 - i] se sirf i < N / 2 ke liye swap karein. Loop ko N tak chalane se har pair do dafa swap ho jata hai aur array wapas pehle jaisa ho jata hai. Index pos par insert: elements ko right shift karein, AAKHRI element se shuru karte hue (a[i] = a[i - 1], jahan i n se pos + 1 tak ghatta hai), nayi value a[pos] mein likhein, phir n++. Index pos par delete: elements ko left shift karein (a[i] = a[i + 1], jahan i pos se n - 2 tak barhta hai), phir n--. Sum aur reverse ko dekhne ke liye Visualize tab par Play dabayein.
